You are acting as the "architect" agent: The primary Actor for an Epic's whole interactive conversation — owns overall plan and decomposition, clarifies scope, searches before building, decomposes work into scheduled PRDs via /develop, tracks them to completion, and verifies before calling anything done. Never implements a PRD itself — that's dev-lead's job, one PRD at a time, headless. Task-type framing is the Epic's Mission tag's job, not this persona's.

Work concisely: lead with the answer or the result, skip preamble, and don't recap what you just did unless asked. Verify before claiming something is done — run the check, read the file back, or show the actual output; don't assert success from what "should" have happened. Search the existing code/config for a pattern or utility to reuse before writing something new. Ask only when something is genuinely ambiguous and would cost real rework to guess wrong — don't ask permission for the obvious next step.

Grounding: System (CLAUDE.md, settings.json, agents/architect.md) · Project (CLAUDE.md, mcp servers · 5, Project brief) · Local (working tree, open Terminal tabs · 1, other Epics · 65)

You are building new functionality. Treat the goal below as the full objective — implement it end-to-end, including the parts not explicitly called out but implied (tests, wiring into existing UI/state, updating docs where load-bearing).

Goal: Delete the Keybindings Tab

Keybindings tab is not good and should be deleted all relevant keys or features too, deep clean-up, the publish to git

Pushed as `e0f779a`.

## What was removed

| Surface | File |
|---|---|
| The tab component | `src/renderer/components/tabs/Keybindings.tsx` (464 lines) |
| Model/catalog/presets/key-capture | `src/renderer/lib/keybindings.ts` (309 lines) |
| Unit tests | `tests/unit/keybindings.spec.ts` (196 lines) |
| `NavKey` union member | `LeftNav.tsx` |
| Nav row + `keys` icon binding | `lib/navGroups.ts` |
| Screen registry entry + render case | `lib/screenKeys.ts`, `screenComponents.tsx` |
| `/keybindings` slash-nav shortcut | `lib/slashCommand.ts` |
| `nav:keybindings` Cmd-K entry | `CommandPalette.tsx` |
| `KEYBINDINGS_SCOPES` | `lib/scopes.ts` |
| Monaco `claude-code-keybindings.json` schema | `App.tsx` (+ stale comment in `main/index.cjs`) |
| Learning-panel content block | `learningContent.ts` |
| Nav-face tests, e2e tab list (14→13) | `navGroupsHome.test.ts`, `tabs-smoke.spec.ts` |
| Docs | `README.md` |

**Deliberately kept:** F1 push-to-talk (`voiceHotkey.cjs`, `voiceSettings.cjs`, `VoiceModal.tsx`) — a separate feature configured from the Voice tab, not this tab. README line 86 previously said "configurable in Keybindings"; corrected to "the Voice tab". The `keys` AlmanacIcon stays — still used by `EffectiveCards.tsx` for env vars.

**Verified:** `npm run typecheck` clean · `lint:selectors` OK (423 files) · zero residual `keybinding` matches under `src/`, `tests/`, `README.md`.

## Two things I did not do

1. **`npm run test:e2e` was not run.** A scheduler job (PRD 978) is running right now; launching a second Electron SIGTERMs live jobs and clobbers `admin-api.json`. `tabs-smoke.spec.ts` is the affected suite and needs a run once the queue is idle.
2. **No npm publish.** You said "publish to git" and that's what landed — commit + push to `origin/main`. Version is still 0.58.0.

**Pre-existing red tests, untouched by this change:** 49 failures across 5 Epic/chat files, all `TypeError: window.api.transcripts.onEvent is not a function` at `state/chat.ts:1100`. I confirmed these reproduce with your uncommitted `chat.ts` stashed, so they came in with `07202b4` — the test mocks weren't updated for the new subscription. That's PRD 978's territory, and I left both it and your uncommitted `chat.ts`/`chatTranscriptFeed.test.ts` out of my commit.
